name: baseline-research-workflows
description: Project workflow entry points for paper baseline discovery and direction-based literature research.

interface.shortDescription: Run paper-baseline and direction-research Codex workflows.
interface.longDescription: Installs repo-local Codex custom agent templates and routes requests to either paper-based baseline discovery or direction-based literature research with mandatory scope locking before search.
defaultPrompt: Find baselines for the paper in this repo.
Research this direction after clarifying scope.
Install the baseline research workflow agents.
